versions.changelog:
claude-clarity-skill v1.1.5

- Updated documentation in README.md and SKILL.md for improved clarity and structure.
- Added or revised localized docs (docs/en/README.md, docs/zh/README.md).
- Updated package.json to reflect new version and possible dependency refinements.
- No code-level changes; this release focuses on doc accuracy and usability.
- Recommended for anyone needing clearer setup or usage instructions.

Version 1.1.4 of claude-clarity-skill:  
- Revised and greatly expanded SKILL.md to provide detailed documentation of system philosophy, core architecture, and key modules.
- Clarified installation and startup instructions, especially integration with MCP native tools and standalone modes.
- Added clear explanation of core concepts: presence, tri-level memory, PAD emotion analysis, truth-goodness-beauty evaluation, and self-verification.
- Introduced feature tables and capability overviews for quick understanding.
- Improved navigation and readability for both human and AI users.
